evidence: The ZIP-labelled CRX contains exactly manifest.json and js/script.js. Declared newtab.html, js/bg.js, locale messages, jQuery and media assets are absent. No missing worker behavior is inferred.

Document-ready initialization reads local shortcut preferences, retrieves a JSON shortcut catalog, repeats that fetch hourly and constructs removable shortcut links. It does not send the preferences to the catalog endpoint.
Search is passed from a click or Enter-key handler to chrome.search.query. The subsequent indexed-URL assignment is conditional source syntax, not evidence of a hostile redirect.
Wallpaper customization uses a user-activated file picker, FileReader.readAsDataURL and localStorage. The clock and tool-popup handlers are ordinary UI.

Record fields enter parsed HTML without escaping. This is an unsafe rendering surface; the supplied code has no executable breakout payload, forced affiliate navigation, credential collection or exfiltration.

The gem metadata, generated gemspec, extconf.rb, C binding, Rake helpers and RSpec tests agree on the package role. The install extension checks for clamav.h and cl_engine_compile and generates a Makefile.

The C constructor initializes and compiles the local ClamAV engine and loads its signature database. scanfile passes the supplied pathname to cl_scanfile and returns a virus name or scan result. It never runs embedded document macros.
The test table explicitly expects W97M.Class.EB for both document fixtures; each is passed to the scanfile method. CL_SCAN_RAW is separately expected not to detect the OLE macro.

OLE VBA source and disassembled p-code were examined. AutoOpen disables macro-virus protection and template-save confirmation, selects NormalTemplate or ActiveDocument based on module line counts, exports a component, imports that source into the selected module and rewrites AutoClose/ToolsMacro handlers. It also rewrites source comments with user/printer/window information and attempts registered-owner/organization writes.
The macro fixture behaviors remain accurately detected, independently of the benign package verdict. No EICAR companion is used to suppress those real behaviors.
The packed JavaScript was decoded without executing it. Its payload implements jQuery Tooltip 1.3 hover/click handlers, HTML tooltips, image fixes and viewport placement.

The 544-byte ClamAV test executable has a feedback-XOR loop. Static decoding yields HELLO WORM followed by a terminator. Rizin identifies only ExitProcess and MessageBoxA imports, and the entry point prepares the message and exits. It has no replication or network path.

Encrypted RAR fixtures are explicitly covered by the test options. The visible encrypted member is clam.exe, size 544, CRC EF073CFD, matching the unencrypted test executable. The fully encrypted archive was not decrypted; failed common-password probes are not evidence about its plaintext.

detection_changes: Removed Gameograf convictions derived only from manifest authority, publisher fields and absent-worker assumptions. Existing generic manifest/search/catalog observations retain the supported facts; Gameograf URLs now live under neutral hostname references. The obsolete custom host-permission rule duplicated the engine-emitted declared-host fact.

Removed the two remote-JSON exploit composites that required rendering mechanics without an executable exploit payload. Existing neutral rendering composites retain the observations; payload-backed XSS rules remain.

Relocated VBA project introspection, source editing, document pathname references, registry imports, template-save preferences and macro-command references to their neutral subjects. Preserved matchers and effective scope, with descriptive/severity corrections documented by the control cases.

Template-injection conviction additionally requires macro-protection disabling; the hostile protection/prompt combination additionally requires an AutoOpen declaration. Ordinary template administration and manually applied preferences are near misses.
Added general detections for VBA registry-write calls, component export, comment rewriting, AV signature expectation tables and x86 feedback-XOR byte transformation.

Relocated Dean Edwards Packer identity from the anti-static objective into the packaging-tool catalog and rewrote all exact consumers. The PE-only TLS consumer of the old parent directory cannot select this JavaScript-only matcher.

Audited destination capacity. Moved existing CLR assembly-load/ShadowCopyFiles and JVM class-loading observations out of reflection, with all rules in their source files accounted for and references rewritten. Moved three existing registry deletion observations from write to delete. The PE UAC parent-selector consumer uses a named neutral group preserving its old member set; the registry ancestor selector still covers both operations.

Moved variable DOM resource-attribute setters from HTTP communication to DOM mutation. Renamed nearby-fetch, URL-navigation and icon-assignment observations to avoid unsupported data-flow, variable-argument and result claims. Manifest worker/update declarations are notable.

No sample code, macros, JavaScript payloads or native test executables were executed.
